snippet.title: [KJFK] - John F. Kennedy Intl Airport by FeelThere for Tower! Simulator 3 - Official trailer
snippet.description:
Website: https://feelthere.com/shop/advertising/kjfk-airport-tower-simulator-3/
Steam Store: https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2176130/view/507324341817442379

Features:
- Realistic modeling with over 100 custom modelled buildings.
- Detailed ground polygon model including taxiway bridges
- Updated selection of Radar screens.
- Modelled Taxi signs.
- Updated taxi light models that follow the curve of the lines and wigwag lights placed at runway entrances.
- Dynamic runway approach lighting with runway sequenced flashers.
- Beautiful background cityscape from OSM (open street maps).
